name: They Hated Jesus Because He Told Them The Truth
look: A black-and-white comic panel. The top caption reads "Most people rejected His message." A dark silhouette of a man at left faces a crowd of scowling bearded men in striped robes and head coverings, one shouting "Shut up!" The bottom caption says they hated Jesus because He told them the truth, citing Gal. 4:16.
text: They hated Jesus because He told them the truth.
use: The silhouette is labeled as someone stating an unpopular but supposedly obvious truth, and the angry crowd as the people who refuse to hear it. Often used ironically for petty hot takes.
slots: the people who reject it (the angry crowd)
examples: Me saying the sequel was better than the original
The rest of the movie club
Me pointing out the meeting could have been an email
